What kind of person do you want to be in life? Do your behaviors and attitude right now reflect who you want to be? If there is a disparity, how will you reconcile it?

I can start.

I have many goals in life, which are framed by the desire to pay it forward to the world. To accomplish those goals, I need to be efficient, focused, and industrious. I want to be a strong father figure (whether I have kids or not), to have moral convictions, to resist temptation, celebrate life through art, and not to fear death.
